Equities Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Monday, November 12th:
Agilent Technologies (NYSE:A) was downgraded by analysts at Cleveland Research from a buy rating to a neutral rating. Get Agilent Technologies Inc alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $266.00 target price by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Centennial Resource Development (NASDAQ:CDEV) was downgraded by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG from an outperform rating to a neutral rating.
Cavco Industries (NASDAQ:CVCO) was given a $170.00 target price by analysts at Craig Hallum. The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock.
Evonik Industries (FRA:EVK) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at DZ Bank AG.
Fraport AG Frankfurt Arprt Svcs Wrldwde (FRA:FRA) was given a €78.00 ($90.70) price target by analysts at Independent Research GmbH. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
freenet (OTCMKTS:FRTAF) had its neutral rating reiterated by analysts at DZ Bank AG.
General Electric (NYSE:GE) had its target price lowered by Credit Suisse Group AG from $12.00 to $10.00. Credit Suisse Group AG currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Infineon Technologies (ETR:IFXA) was given a €21.50 ($25.00) target price by analysts at Independent Research GmbH. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Inditex (BME:ITX) was given a €32.00 ($37.21) target price by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
LEG Immobilien (FRA:LEG) was given a €98.10 ($114.07) price target by analysts at Nord/LB. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Altria Group (NYSE:MO) had its outperform rating reaffirmed by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co.
Citigroup Inc started coverage on shares of PhaseBio Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:PHAS) . They issued a buy rating and a $18.00 target price on the stock.
Smart Sand (NASDAQ:SND) was downgraded by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG from a neutral rating to an underperform rating.
Senior Housing Properties Trust (NASDAQ:SNH) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at B. Riley. The firm currently has a $21.00 target price on the stock, down from their previous target price of $23.00.
Ubiquiti Networks (NASDAQ:UBNT) was given a $86.00 price target by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock.
